decisions.reason: After two years without website evidence, this close-to-core but small plugin appears to have revealed limited standalone demand, so its remaining option value is low relative to the cost of keeping it active.

Although strategically complementary to multichannel commerce, the lack of visibility since 2020 suggests the standalone ERP interface plugin has likely not scaled enough and is better folded into project work than kept as a separate market offering.
A price-comparison tracking plugin that has not been observed for two years and sits in an overlapping trio offers little additional learning now, so management would likely prune it.
With uncertainty largely resolved and clear portfolio redundancy among similar tracking plugins, this product is unlikely to justify continued standalone support.
Given prolonged non-observation and overlap with other price-comparison tracking plugins, the firm would likely reallocate resources from this option to stronger core and new development priorities.
This reporting plugin is adjacent to the firm's analytics capabilities, but two years without website presence indicate weak standalone traction and reduce the case for keeping it on the market.
